text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen is the grand 
stage of sprinting. Naturally, Aston 
Machan, walking the sprint path, is fully 
fired up, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The view count on the 4-panel blog, which 
had been doing so well until now, had been 
dropping at an eerily steep rate lately.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, Aston Machan's condition 
was—perhaps because it was spring?—not 
looking very good. Amid such an ominous 
start, the race was about to begin...
